project.name: Mat The - Sinh Hoa Nguy Co

backend.note: Oracle production debugging requires checking the live Render commit rollout rather than assuming GitHub push is already active.

current_focus.area: Multilingual translation pipeline, admin translation ops, and payload efficiency
current_focus.summary: Implemented 4-locale architecture across reader/homepage/admin flows, AI key x model rotation, batch translation for chapters and wiki, translation status tracking, and reduced translation request count by bundling chapter/homepage/wiki payloads into one request per locale. Latest work also hardens JSON payload parsing and makes batch network errors clearer in admin.

gotchas.title: Do not paste git diff into Supabase SQL Editor
gotchas.detail: Supabase accepts raw SQL only. Patch text starting with diff --git will fail with syntax error 42601.

gotchas.title: HTTP 200 does not guarantee usable Oracle output
gotchas.detail: Gemini can return successful but semantically broken/truncated text; backend must validate answer quality.

gotchas.title: Oracle cache can preserve bad answers
gotchas.detail: Stale rows in oracle_cache can poison UX even after model and deployment issues are fixed.

gotchas.title: Floating reader controls need adaptive placement
gotchas.detail: Fixed-corner placement is fragile on mobile; draggable triggers and minimized diagnostics reduce control overlap.

gotchas.title: Translation success can fail on JSON parsing even with HTTP 200
gotchas.detail: Gemini may return JSON wrapped in fences, include control characters, or produce malformed strings. Translation pipelines now need payload cleaning and parse-retry across models.

gotchas.title: Batch translation progress is durable only at published-row boundaries
gotchas.detail: When only_missing=true, reruns skip locales already published. Failed/incomplete locales are retried, so network interruptions usually cost time rather than losing completed work.

gotchas.title: Wiki translations were read-only before 2026-03-27
gotchas.detail: The repo already had wiki_entry_translations lookup, but no AI generation pipeline or admin controls until this session.
